page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m2.large is an entry-tier shared virtual machine instance designed for light computing requirements and burstable resource consumption. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this instance provision provides 2 burstable vCPUs derived from a single physical core with two threads on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The x86_64 architecture incorporates 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of shared L3 cache, alongside support for instruction sets including AVX, AVX-512, and AES-NI.

The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not bundle dedicated local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage solutions, and features no dedicated GPU accelerators. Baseline network throughput is listed at 0 Gbps with no complimentary public IPv4 addresses assigned by default. Benchmark scores reflect the constrained shared-core allocation: PassMark CPU recorded 2464.26, while Geekbench returned scores of 1045.0 for single-core and 1850.0 for multi-core tests, placing general compute performance in the lower percentiles across evaluated cloud tiers.

Memory bandwidth measurements demonstrate 20.68 GB/sec for uncached read-only blocks and 16.39 GB/sec for write operations, matching the performance envelope expected from entry-level hardware. Application benchmarks show Redis SET operations reaching 2.57 million operations per second and static web throughput of 2.44 GB/sec, while CPU-bound tasks like Clang compilation registered lower throughput. Cost efficiency is centered on minimal resource footprints where sustained compute capacity is not required.

Given its burstable CPU credits and compact 4.0 GB memory footprint, Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m2.large is best suited for low-traffic web services, background utilities, development and test sandboxes, microservices, and lightweight administrative workloads that tolerate intermittent CPU throttling.

Synthetic benchmarks reflect its shared, burstable nature, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1045.0, a multi-core score of 1850.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 2464.26.
